source: Click and pain on ulna deviation of the wrist which is considered to be permanent;

source: Keloid formation over left thigh and leg.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the hip or thigh

manifestations.description: Bump on the back of her head the size of a tennis ball
Initial pain for 1 to 2 weeks after the operation
Some stiffness likely after removal of cast
Click and discomfort on ulnar deviation with pain at extreme ranges; difficulty fastening a bra strap; pain carrying a full school bag
Faint pale scar on the face
Three noticeable scars on the inner left thigh near the knee (keloidal)
Anxiety/consciousness of her scars, prefers long pants and is self-conscious in games/swimwear
Mental anguish or nervous shock attendant on the accident (immediate aftermath)

treatments_received: Operation performed from 11 p.m. on the day of the accident to 1 a.m. on the following day (orthopaedic surgery)
Suturing and re-stitching of facial and leg injuries
Follow-up consultations on 16 and 24 September 1985, 28 October 1985 and 17 December 1988

losses.description: Keloidal and other scars on left thigh and pale facial scar causing ongoing anxiety and reduced enjoyment of life

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Difficulty for several months with simple daily routine such as washing, opening doors, and buttoning clothes (tasks requiring two hands)

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Discomfort and limitation with gymnastics, push ups and some activities such as tennis and typing; worry about breaking wrist and some diminution of sporting activities
